record.name: Finma - AI Finance Tracker
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Finma short for finance manager, is your personal finance assistant that helps you track & plan all your expenses in one place. 

Built with the primary goal of automating your expenses, Finma is the only app on the App Store which supports all of the following ways to automate expenses:

- SMS Automation
- Email Sync
- Direct bank connection via Plaid
- AI PDF import
- AI CSV import

Features:

- Privacy First
Finma stores all your financial data locally on-device. Not even we have access to your transactions.

- Generous Free Tier
The free tier allows you to create unlimited transaction entries, unlimited budgets and unlimited rules. Track up to 3 subscriptions for free.

- Budget Alerts
Say goodbye to overspending on your gadget addiction. Set category wise budgets and get alerted when they cross a set threshold.

- Rule Based Auto-Categorization
Finma uses rules for automatic categorisation of transactions. A rule can either be a simple text that matches any text within the transaction description or for more advanced users a regex to match pattern.

- Subscription Tracking
A beautiful calendar view shows all your recurring transactions at a glance. Keep your subscriptions in check and manage them efficiently.

- Payment Reminders
Track upcoming dues for all your cards and get reminded to clear them on time. Set custom reminders to get reminded up to a week in advance.

- Visual Filtering
Find the transactions you need even faster with a visual approach in Finma.
Suppose you need to see all the restaurant spends you did in month of Feb. Simply select Restaurants from the categories bar followed by tapping Feb bar in graph.

- Interactive Charts
All charts and graphs in Finma are interactive. 
Example: You want to find out how much you spent on restaurants and shopping combined in Feb. Select Shopping and then Restaurants from the categories bar followed by tapping Feb bar in graph.

- Cash Flow
Know your overall financial health with just 1 glance. Easily understand how your income and investments compare on an average within a period.
The cash flow widget allows you to quickly skim through previous months to get better clarity on past health and helps to plan better.

- PDF Import
Import transactions in bulk by importing PDF statements or using the built-in image scan feature to scan documents and receipts.

- Email Sync
Import transactions automatically from emails. If your bank sends you transaction emails, Finma will try to parse them and generate transactions automatically.

- SMS Sync
Import transactions automatically from SMS using Shortcuts automation. If your bank sends you transaction alerts on SMS, Finma will try to parse them and generate transactions automatically.

- Direct Bank Sync
We have partnered with Plaid to support all major banks across US and Canada. Bank data is synced directly to device, we do not store any personal user data on our servers.

---

What's completely free:
- Unlimited transactions
- Unlimited rules
- Unlimited budgets
- Track up to 3 subscriptions
- Payment reminders
- Budget alerts
- Interactive charts and filters

The following features require purchasing Premium subscription:
- Direct bank sync using Plaid (US & Canada only)
- AI related tasks such as document scanning, sms & email parsing
- Adding more than 1 account
- Custom categories
- Custom app icons

---

Have questions or need help? Email us at support@finma.money

record.description_evidence:
Streetbeat is a brokerage account with an analyst inside. Ask Warren why a stock moved, get a note on your holdings at the open and the close, and buy stocks, ETFs and crypto commission-free, all in one app. Available in the US, UK and EU, in seven languages.

ASK WARREN
Why did this stock fall today? What did the company really say last quarter? How much of my money is riding on Nvidia once you count my ETFs? Warren pulls live quotes, financials, news and your own positions to answer. Drop in a screenshot or a PDF and Warren reads it too. Every answer has a thumbs-down, and every thumbs-down lands in front of a person on our team.

THE BEAT
Two short notes a day, written for what you hold. The Opening Beat lands before the bell with what moved overnight and which of your companies report earnings. The Closing Beat wraps up the session and the week's economic data. Past days stay in the app, so you can go back and see whether it held up.

SEE WHAT YOU ACTUALLY OWN
Open any company and Streetbeat estimates your real exposure to it: shares you bought directly, plus what you hold through ETFs and portfolios. Most people are surprised.

PORTFOLIOS THAT KEEP THEMSELVES IN LINE
Build one with Warren or pick one of ours, like "U.S. Congress Buys", which follows the stocks that members of Congress have reported buying. Set your target allocation and Streetbeat rebalances to it on the schedule you choose, from daily to quarterly. Add a recurring deposit and the investing happens whether you remember or not.

TALK TO PEOPLE WHO HOLD THE SAME THING
Every stock, ETF and portfolio has its own room. Post what you're seeing, read what everyone else is saying, and follow the ones you want to hear from again. When someone posts about a stock they hold, the app says so: we confirm the position at the moment they post, and never show how much. Report, mute and block sit behind every post.

ALREADY ON ROBINHOOD?
Connect your Robinhood account and run Streetbeat portfolios inside it. Your money stays where it is.

STOCKS, ETFS AND CRYPTO, ONE ACCOUNT
No commission on stocks and ETFs. Every order shows the estimated cost before you confirm. Crypto trades around the clock; stock orders placed after hours execute when the market opens.

NOTHING SLIPS PAST YOU
Price alerts on anything you watch. Dividend and earnings dates for the companies you hold. News filtered to your positions. Home and lock screen widgets show your account value and upcoming dividends and earnings without opening the app.

Fund from a US, UK or EU bank account. Available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Polish and Russian.

Warren and The Beat are generated by AI, can be wrong, and are not personalized investment advice. Community posts are written by users, not by Streetbeat, and are not advice or recommendations. The Nodle app is your all-in-one crypto wallet, rewards hub and web3 messenger. Turn your smartphone into a node of the global Nodle Network, earn NODL by completing real-world missions, then swap, send and pay anywhere without expensive hardware or giving up your data.

Whether you are new to crypto or already deep in web3, Nodle gives you a clean, private way to grow a digital wallet and use it like real money.

No mining rigs. No email needed. No personal info required. Just a free crypto wallet that pays you back for being part of something bigger.

—— JOIN ——
• Anonymous wallet in seconds: no email needed
• Activate the Nodle Network mission and your phone becomes a node of a worldwide Bluetooth network
• Bring in what you already own. Mesh imports assets from Binance, Coinbase and MetaMask into your Nodle wallet
• Discover new missions as they go live across the Nodle ecosystem

—— EARN ——
• Earn NODL tokens daily, hands-free, by running the app in the background
• Take on passive and active smart missions using your phone's sensors
• Mint and collect commemorative NFTs from events and drops
• Track every reward, mission and transaction inside the app
• Optimized for minimal battery use; typically 1–3% per 24h via Bluetooth Low Energy
• Restrict data transmission to Wi-Fi only if you prefer

—— PAY ——

• Send Envelopes: crypto, NFTs or gifts to anyone, even friends who don't have Nodle yet
• Chat 1:1 or in groups with end-to-end encrypted messaging powered by XMTP, and send value inside the conversation
• Book your Nodle debit card (coming soon) and spend your crypto anywhere cards are accepted
• Send and receive NODL and supported tokens to strengthen the network

—— YOUR PRIVATE, ON-DEVICE AI ASSISTANT ——
• Ask Nodle AI simple questions about your day, right inside the app
• Turn on the optional Apple Health connection to ask about steps, heart rate, sleep and workouts
• Everything runs on your device: your health data is read locally, summarized locally and never sent to Nodle or any third party
• Read-only access, only to what you approve, and off by default. Switch it on or off anytime in Nodle AI Settings > Connectors
• Not a medical service: no diagnosis and no treatment advice, just clear answers about your own activity

No email required. No personal info needed. Your wallet is fully anonymous. Location data is only used to compute your contribution and locate devices at the request of their owners — never sold, never shared.

Any optional data source, such as Apple Health, works the same way: read locally, used locally and never uploaded. Each mission and connector tells you exactly what it collects; the choice is always yours.

—— LIGHT ON YOUR PHONE ——
Engineered for low CPU and battery use. Bluetooth Low Energy keeps the impact tiny, and you can restrict data transmission to Wi-Fi only.

—— WHY NODLE? ——
Earn crypto passively — no hardware, no mining rigs
• All-in-one wallet — swap, bridge, send, message and pay
• Built on a decentralized web3 network with thousands of contributors worldwide
• Designed for beginners and crypto pros alike
• Battery-friendly using Bluetooth Low Energy
• Anonymous and privacy-first
• On-device AI assistant, so even your health and fitness data stays on your phone

—— LEARN ABOUT CRYPTO ——
New to crypto, blockchain or web3? Inside the app you'll find guides that make it easy to understand how the Nodle Network works, how to earn NODL and how to use your crypto wallet safely.

—— A GROWING WEB3 ECOSYSTEM ——
Built on a decentralized network with thousands of contributors worldwide, Nodle is reinventing how people earn and use crypto — from Bluetooth missions to messaging, payments and a real-world card.

—— REACH US ——
Discord, Telegram, X (Twitter), YouTube our team is happy to help.

Download Nodle today - join, earn and pay.

PORTFOLIO TRACKER

ADVANCED CHARTS & TECHNICAL ANALYSIS

Draw trend lines, Fibonacci retracements and fans, channels, and more with 14 drawing tools. Replay past price action bar by bar.

STOCK SCREENER
Scan NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, TSX, LSE, ASX, NSE, NZX, and more with 100+ fundamental and technical criteria. Save your screens and rerun them anytime.

TREND SCORE & BACKTESTING
Rank stocks by trend strength with Trend Score, built on backtested technical strategies — then test your own trading strategies against historical data.

BEYOND STOCKS
Futures on major world indexes, live forex rates, US Treasury yields, commodities, ETFs, options chains, an earnings calendar, and top cryptocurrencies.

MARKET NEWS
Business and finance headlines from leading sources including CNBC, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, Forbes, Business Insider, and more.

HOME-SCREEN WIDGETS
Six widgets keep the market on your home screen: single stock, watchlist, portfolio summary, portfolio list, market heat map, and index comparison.

PRACTICE & COMMUNITY
Sharpen your skills with virtual trading on real-time quotes, climb the leaderboard, and see what other investors are discussing.

ChartGPT is an AI-powered trading assistant that helps you explore financial markets, understand technical analysis, and learn trading concepts through natural conversations. Managing money does not have to be stressful. Powered by OpenAI ChatGPT 5.2 and GPT-4o, our personal finance app helps you track spending, plan budgets, and grow your savings with clarity and confidence. Designed for simplicity yet packed with powerful features, this expense tracker and money manager helps you stay in control of your finances while keeping your mind at ease.

Why Choose This App?
Most finance apps stop at tracking expenses. We go further. By combining AI, gamification, and collaborative tools, we make money management effective and engaging. Whether budgeting for daily life, saving for a goal, or managing shared expenses, this budget planner adapts to your needs.

Key Features That Matter

- Smart Transaction Creation with ChatGPT 5.2 and GPT-4o
Add transactions manually or let AI do the work for you. Simply snap a photo, type, or use your voice. Powered by ChatGPT 5.2 and GPT-4o, the AI instantly recognises and records your spending or income.

- Flexible Time Management
Record transactions for today, the future, or any past date. Perfect for planning bills, subscriptions, or catching up on forgotten entries.

- Recurring Transactions
Automate your routine expenses or income with customizable cycles: daily, weekly, monthly, or custom periods.

- 28+ Categories for Income and Expenses
Keep your finances organised with a rich set of categories, making it easy to see where your money goes.

- Budget Tracker with Gamification
Set budgets and stay motivated with progress tracking, achievements, and playful gamification elements that turn financial discipline into a rewarding challenge.

- Savings Goals with Gamification
Save for a trip, a new gadget, or an emergency fund. The app turns your savings goals into interactive milestones, keeping you inspired along the way.

- Debt Tracker with Gamification
Manage debts and repayments with clarity. Gamified progress helps you stay on track and celebrate every step toward becoming debt-free.

- Bill Splitting Made Simple
Easily split bills after spending. The design is intentionally simple, so you can settle shared costs without hassle.

- Shared Expense Management
Collaborate with friends, family, or roommates. Multiple users can manage and track shared expenses together in one place.

- Multiple AI Personalities
Choose how your AI assistant interacts with you, from professional and analytical to friendly and motivational. Personal finance advice, your way.

How ChatGPT 5.2 and GPT-4o Make the Difference
Our AI is not just a calculator. Powered by OpenAI ChatGPT 5.2 and GPT-4o, it is a personal finance coach that understands your spending habits, adapts to your lifestyle, and provides actionable insights. From categorising expenses to suggesting smarter ways to save money, the AI works in the background so you can focus on living your life.

Privacy and Security
Your trust is our priority. All data is encrypted and stored securely. You remain in full control. Request account deletion anytime from the app and your data will be erased within 60 days.

Who Is This App For?
- Students learning to manage their first budget
- Professionals balancing income, expenses, and savings
- Families planning for shared financial goals
- Friends or roommates managing group expenses
- Anyone who wants to reduce financial stress and gain peace of mind

Download Today
Money should empower you, not overwhelm you. With the AI Finance Assistant, you will gain clarity, confidence, and calmness in your financial life. Download now and let AI help you build the future you deserve.
